name: product-manager
description: Product management toolkit for authoring PRDs and turning them into executable, agent-ready implementation plans.

interface.shortDescription: Write PRDs and turn product ideas into implementation plans.
interface.longDescription: Product Manager ships two skills: prd-writer authors and critiques PRDs, specs, one-pagers, and PR/FAQs; prd-to-plan converts a PRD into a structured PLAN.md for agentic execution with phases, tasks, dependencies, and validation gates.
defaultPrompt: Help me write a PRD or turn product work into an implementation plan.
